title: Citrus-Glazed Slovakian Cakes
description: Moist Slovakian cakes infused with a tangy citrus glaze, perfect for a sweet breakfast treat.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together Slovakian, citrus, and tart.
In a separate bowl, whisk egg and honey until smooth.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Allow cakes to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
Once cakes are cool, whisk together citrus and tart to make the glaze.
Drizzle glaze over the cooled cakes.
